content.text:
All 8 tests pass now.

In `invoices/money.py`, `to_cents` truncated the binary float (so 19.99 became 1998 cents), which violated rule 1; it and `percent_of` now go through `Decimal` with explicit half-up rounding. In `invoices/invoice.py`, tax was computed on the undiscounted subtotal, violating rules 2 and 3, so I added a `discounted_subtotal` step and made both `tax` and `total` build on it.
